'''Kryalyn''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]], and is also of the [[Black Ajah]].
== History ==
Kryalyn is the second-in-command of [[Aelidas]] as part of the [[White Tower]]'s mission against [[Mazrim Taim]] when he declares himself to be a [[False Dragon]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
